create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with a dataloader, EvalUnit, and optional callbacks for evaluation
run_eval_runner: run the EvalRunner to evaluate a model using TorchTNT's evaluate function with the configured dataloader
configure_eval_callbacks: configure an EvalRunner with a list of TorchTNT callbacks for custom evaluation hooks
set_max_steps_per_epoch: set the max_steps_per_epoch parameter on EvalRunner to limit evaluation steps per epoch
review_eval_runner_class: review the EvalRunner class that wraps TorchTNT evaluate with save and load state stubs
